title: The big man at the feast

plan.english: Chief, who is that big man? He is my nephew. Yesterday he seized three men and laid them on the ground. Will he fight against me? He will fight against you, and you will fall down. I am strong, and my arms are thick. Then go, and may the gods give you strength!

title: Carry the calf on all days

plan.english: Brother, look! I am carrying the calf on my shoulders. That calf is small. Carry it on all days! Why shall I carry it? The calf is growing, and your arms are growing. When it is a bull, you will still carry it. Then I will lay the warriors on the ground! Then I will be afraid of you, little brother.
